votes.motion: To approve the May 9, 2024 Planning Commission Meeting minutes

To recommend file #OAM2024-001175 The City of Magna is considering the adoption of the Magna Historic District Area Plan. The plan area encompasses nearly two square miles of the northwest corner of urban Magna, bounded by the H201 corridor to the north and U111 8400 w. corridor to the east. This plan will provide guidance to the municipality on updates to district open space and streetscape environments as well as provide a framework for accomplishing context appropriate development and renovation in and around Magna’s historic core.
